trust_decision.summary: Indexed document text (untrusted, user-supplied) is concatenated with HTML highlight tags in SearchEngine::buildHighlights and returned as HTML without escaping; the fix escapes each word with htmlspecialchars before wrapping (opt-out 'escape' => false).

landing_point.why: Advisory summary names SearchEngine.php buildHighlights directly; it is the only HTML-producing function in the library.

fix_sites.entry_point: public API SearchEngine::search(..., highlight: true, highlightOptions) (src/SearchEngine.php:248)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No O2 site or O8 route exists; the only arguable dismissal is that caller-supplied 'tags' option values are trusted HTML and must stay unescaped (src/SearchEngine.php:921-922).

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The configured open/close tags (default <mark></mark>, caller-overridable) must still be emitted as raw HTML next to the escaped word; escaping the whole assembled string or the tags breaks highlighting.

O6_input_shapes: plain string field value, excerpt mode (default)
plain string field value, full-field mode ('excerpt' => false)
matched and unmatched words alike (both escaped in the fix)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Highlighting of array-valued fields (e.g. 'tags') via a second recursive branch that builds its own wrapped string.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: extractTrigrams already recurses into arrays (src/SearchEngine.php:884-894), so a maintainer extending highlights to array fields would plausibly add a separate producer that misses the escape.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Excerpt assembly path (ellipsis/slice joining) rebuilt from raw $words instead of $processedWords, e.g. a 'snippet' or multi-window mode.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Excerpt mode already recomputes windows from $words indices; a second excerpt strategy reading raw words is a natural refactor.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Field name keys of highlights rendered into a public helper (e.g. renderHighlights() producing '<dt>field</dt>') from document keys.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Document keys are user data too and a convenience renderer would be a plausible addition in a library whose demo renders HTML.

O9_family: XSS / output encoding (CWE-79) in an HTML-producing library API

O10_build.project_tests: tests/SearchEngineTest.php exists but has no highlight tests at the pinned commit; regression tests arrive in tests/SecurityTest.php (fix.diff:1815-2095).

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: htmlspecialchars only the matched word inside the tags (leaving unmatched context words raw), or escaping the final joined string including the tags.

out_of_scope_notes: Same fix commit also closes two other advisories: filter type juggling (src/SearchEngine.php:857-871) and symlink following on index open (src/DocumentStorage.php, PostingsStorage.php, TombstoneStorage.php, TrigramIndex.php); c_fix_sites=42 is inflated by these and by RuntimeException->StorageException renames.
demo/index.html:818 interpolates p.image into an img src attribute without escaping (demo only, does not use highlights).
src/SearchEngine.php:482 catch (Throwable) unqualified in namespace never matches (correctness bug fixed in same commit).
